A species of nearly-extinct '''Gnithian [[Insect/Legends|insect]]''' was responsible for transmission of [[ix dbukrii]] in the wild. They sucked [[Blood/Legends|blood]], and apparently fed on [[Gnithian oep]]s, which were the primary host of the ix dbukrii.
